units.source_text: 现在我完成了自身的这个要求，再也没有什么要做的事情了。

en.t: Now I have fulfilled this demand of my own, and there is nothing more left for me to do.

units.source_text: 这封信到达你手里的时候，我大概已经不在这个世上，早已死去了。

en.t: By the time this letter reaches your hands, I will probably no longer be in this world, but will already have died.

units.source_text: 大约十天前，妻子去了住在市谷的婶母家，是我劝她去的，妻子说婶母生病，需要人去照应。

en.t: About ten days ago, my wife went to her aunt's house in Ichigaya; I was the one who urged her to go, because she said her aunt was ill and needed someone to look after her.

units.source_text: 妻子不在家的时候，我写了这封长信的大部分内容。

en.t: While my wife was away from home, I wrote most of this long letter.

units.source_text: 每当妻子隔三差五回来时，我就马上把信藏起来。

en.t: Whenever my wife came home from time to time, I immediately hid the letter.

units.source_text: 我打算把我的过去，无论是善还是恶，全都提供给人们作为参考。

en.t: I intend to offer my past, whether good or evil, entirely as a lesson for others.

units.source_text: 但是，你需明白，只有我妻一个人例外，我什么都不想让她知道。

en.t: But you must understand that my wife alone is the one exception; I do not want her to know anything at all.

units.source_text: 因为，让妻子对我的过去尽量保有一份纯洁的回忆，是我唯一的愿望。

en.t: For my only wish is that my wife should preserve, as far as possible, a pure memory of my past.

units.source_text: 所以，我要拜托你，即使在我死后，只要我妻还活着，你就把它们作为我只告诉你一个人的秘密，全部埋藏在你的心底吧。”

en.t: So I ask this of you: even after my death, as long as my wife is still alive, please bury all of this deep in your heart as a secret I have told to you alone."

units.source_text: 1.西南战争：发生于1877年，是以明治维新功臣之一的西乡隆盛为代表的封建势力发动的反明治维新的叛乱，当年失败。

en.t: 1. The Satsuma Rebellion: This occurred in 1877 and was an anti-Meiji Restoration revolt launched by feudal forces represented by Saigo Takamori, one of the leading figures of the Meiji Restoration; it failed that same year.

units.source_text: 2.渡边华山（1793—1841）：日本学者、政治家、画家，幕末藩士。

en.t: 2. Watanabe Kazan (1793-1841): A Japanese scholar, politician, painter, and domain retainer of the late Tokugawa period.

units.source_text: 3.《黄粱一炊图》：华山按照邯郸之梦的故事，画了此图，并留下五封遗书后，于1841年10月11日自杀。

en.t: 3. The Painting of One Cooking of Yellow Millet: Kazan painted this picture based on the story of the Dream of Handan, and after leaving behind five farewell letters, he killed himself on October 11, 1841.
